panel.title: Editor
panel.infotextStationTab: Right-click on map to add station.
panel.infotextLinesTab: Right-click on route (or other line on that route if already assigned) to assign route to the selected line (line must be selected by click in the list). Lines are expected to be continuous, but can branch. Set operated directions and timetables for each line individually with its timetable button. Right-click + CTRL to remove clicked route from selected line.
panel.infotextRoutesTab: Right-click on station or junction to start creating route, right-click on place in map to change direction (start another segment), and right-click on second station or junction to finish the route. Right-click the point on route to create junction. Set travel times for routes to be used by timetables.

timetable.name: Name
timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.infotextTrafficTimebar: Set busy hours and quiet hours for traffic, so that corresponding travel times on routes are used for timetable generation. Left-click to increase traffic level of the segment (each representing half an hour), right-click to decrease. Drag to set multiple segments to one level.
timetable.infotextDirectionControls: Sequence represents an interval of vehicles operating in specified direction. Use passthrough stations if the path deviates from the shortest one between start and final station (taken via the line's routes). Last departure is limited by time after which no further departure will be generated. Multiple sequences on the same direction will be automatically merged and sorted in the timetable for that direction.
